author: Khan Academy
description:
While in electrostatic equilibrium, the excess charge of a conductor is distributed on the surface of the conductor, and the electric field within the conductor is zero. At the surface of a charged conductor, the electric field is perpendicular to the surface. While in electrostatic equilibrium, the excess charge of an insulator may be distributed throughout the interior of the insulator as well as at the surface, and the electric field within the insulator may have a nonzero value.

Sections: 
00:00 - Charge distribution on conductors
02:12 - Electric field inside a conductor
05:11 - Electric fields at conductor surfaces
08:14 - Spherical conductors and point charges
